elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor shall provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 states: “On expiry or termination Vendor shall continue transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance shall be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 expressly provides transition assistance “for up to 6 months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance shall be provided at then-current rates.
Vendor shall return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires Vendor, “[w]ithin 30 days after expiry or termination,” to return all Customer Data.

elements.element: Customer Data shall be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires a “documented, standard machine-readable format” and also requires completeness, relationships, and necessary metadata.

elements.element: Vendor shall delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Section 11.3 requires secure deletion of remaining Customer Data after Customer confirms successful return, subject to backup cycling and the Applicable Law exception.

elements.element: Vendor shall certify deletion after the return.
elements.evidence: Under Section 11.3, following confirmed successful return and deletion, an authorized officer must certify deletion in writing.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor shall provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 expressly requires transition assistance on expiry or termination.

elements.element: Transition assistance shall be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 provides a transition-assistance period of up to 6 months, encompassing and exceeding the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor shall export Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, satisfying the data-export requirement.

result.reason: The operative language implements the preferred six-month transition-assistance period and pricing, a termination-triggered 30-day data return in the required format, and post-return deletion certification. It therefore also satisfies the shorter fallback. The remaining metadata, fee-dispute, backup, legal-retention, and data-protection provisions are related safeguards rather than unrelated commercial changes. Drafting quality is reduced by the awkward phrase “an export or migration support” and the potentially imprecise expression “for up to 6 months,” although both required positions are substantively covered.
